## Checklist
- [ ] `python3 tests/test_rainbowomma.py` passes
- [ ] A test covers the behavior change (fakes only — no real browser or app)
- [ ] Status words, JSON keys and exit codes are unchanged, or the change is in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] New user-facing text is in `bin/rainbow_i18n.py`, in every language
- [ ] Examples use the placeholders `alpha` / `bravo` / `charlie` / `human`
